cues.en: Hi, and welcome to this AI-to-Share video about the Responses API.
cues.zh: 大家好，這支 C# AI 影片要介紹 Responses API。

cues.en: And a thing I had completely missed in that image generation is actually possible through the Responses API.
cues.zh: 有一項我之前完全沒注意到的功能：Responses API 其實也能產生圖片。

cues.en: I knew that we could do web search tools, we could do code interpreter tools, and so on.
cues.zh: 我知道它有網頁搜尋、Code Interpreter 等工具，

cues.en: And I knew we could use images and PDFs as input, but I didn't know actually we could get images out from Responses API.
cues.zh: 也知道能輸入圖片與 PDF，但之前不知道也能直接輸出圖片。

cues.en: And if you didn't know too, then this video is for you, because let's have a look at how that works.
cues.zh: 如果你也不知道，這支影片就是為你準備的，接著看看運作方式。

cues.en: So here I am in a project down here called Image Generation from Responses OpenAPI.
cues.zh: 這裡有一個 Image Generation from Responses OpenAI 專案。

cues.en: And I have made image generation before.
cues.zh: 之前已經介紹過圖片生成。

cues.en: That is quite easy in that you get an image client out of either Azure OpenAI and OpenAI.
cues.zh: 做法很簡單，從 Azure OpenAI 或 OpenAI 取得 ImageClient 即可。

cues.en: But this came about whenever I talked with someone about the Microsoft Foundry, where we in Foundry, our third way of doing things here.
cues.zh: 這次是因為和別人討論 Microsoft Foundry，也就是我們第三種用戶端使用方式時，

cues.en: Let me get rid of these.
cues.zh: 先把這些關掉，

cues.en: When we get our project client here, our client here, we can get our responses.
cues.zh: 從 ProjectClient 取得用戶端，再取得 Responses，

cues.en: I get project client.
cues.zh: 這裡先拿到 ProjectClient。

cues.en: And we can actually get something called an image client, but whenever you use this, it fails.
cues.zh: 其實也能取得 ImageClient，但一使用就會失敗。

cues.en: So it couldn't be used.
cues.zh: 所以無法真正使用。

cues.en: And for that reason, I talked with someone and said, well, we can't really get rid of Azure OpenAI client because we don't have the image client.
cues.zh: 因此我和別人說，既然沒有可用的 ImageClient，就還不能完全移除 AzureOpenAIClient。

cues.en: And then they mentioned, but you can do that with Responses API.
cues.zh: 結果對方說，Responses API 就能產生圖片。

cues.en: And I was just, what?
cues.zh: 我當時的反應是：什麼？

cues.en: You can do that?
cues.zh: 原來可以這樣？

cues.en: But let me show you how it's done.
cues.zh: 接著示範做法。

cues.en: And I can't understand why I missed it, because you can have a model and an image model just like you normally do.
cues.zh: 其實不知道自己為什麼漏看了，因為照常指定一般模型與圖片模型即可。

cues.en: And then let me close down Azure.
cues.zh: 先把 Azure 的部分關掉。

cues.en: Because we're going to show it with OpenAI first because that's the easy one to get going.
cues.zh: 我們先示範 OpenAI，因為最容易開始。

cues.en: And what you do is you grab your responses client like normal and turn it into an agent.
cues.zh: 像平常一樣取得 Responses Client，再轉成代理程式。

cues.en: But we have something called a hosted image generation tool.
cues.zh: 不過這裡有 HostedImageGenerationTool。

cues.en: And that hosted generation image tool can grab some, set some image generation options, type, model, size, and so on.
cues.zh: 這個託管圖片生成工具可以設定格式、模型、尺寸等選項。

cues.en: And when you have one of these agents, we suddenly have one that can just do normal text, like asking what the capital of France is,
cues.zh: 建立代理程式後，一方面能像平常一樣問法國首都，

cues.en: and get a response back.
cues.zh: 取得文字回覆。

cues.en: And we can also, using that tool, generate images.
cues.zh: 另一方面也能透過這個工具產生圖片。

cues.en: This takes a little while.
cues.zh: 圖片生成會需要一點時間。

cues.en: And also remember that you pay for the image generation more than you do with normal tokens.
cues.zh: 另外也記得，圖片生成的計費和一般文字 Token 不同。

cues.en: So go up and check your prices for that.
cues.zh: 請先查看對應的價格。

cues.en: It's not cheap, but it's not too, too expensive either.
cues.zh: 不算特別便宜，但也沒有到非常昂貴。

cues.en: When we generate an image, we get back a response.
cues.zh: 圖片產生後，會取得一個回覆。

cues.en: It's empty because the response is an image, and that is the layout deep site inside the message and inside some content here.
cues.zh: 直接輸出文字會是空白，因為回覆是圖片，放在訊息內部的 Content 中。

cues.en: Let me loop through it.
cues.zh: 我們用迴圈查看。

cues.en: So for each message we go to, we go to the content of those.
cues.zh: 逐一走過訊息，再查看各自的 Content。

cues.en: So there's three of that.
cues.zh: 這裡有三個項目。

cues.en: There's a tool called result, and then there's the empty text because there was no output.
cues.zh: 其中有工具結果，以及因為沒有文字輸出而產生的空文字。

cues.en: And it's actually not the first one here with the image generation tool, but the result we are interested in.
cues.zh: 真正要找的不是前面那個圖片生成工具呼叫，而是它的結果。

cues.en: Because if we look at our tool here, you can see we have some output.
cues.zh: 查看工具結果，可以看到 Output。

cues.en: And that output is actually a base 64, or if we want to get it as bytes as well.
cues.zh: Output 包含 Base64，也能取出原始位元組。

cues.en: So if we go to every output and get the data content, as it's called, we can actually get the base 64 if you want to just place it on the website,
cues.zh: 因此可以逐一取得 DataContent；如果要放在網站，能直接使用 Base64，

cues.en: or we can use, in my case, the raw bytes, put them down into a file and start that file.
cues.zh: 或像我這裡取得原始位元組，寫入檔案，再開啟檔案。

cues.en: So if I see a break point up here, let it run, it will generate a cute dog.
cues.zh: 在上方設中斷點並執行，就會產生一隻可愛的小狗。

cues.en: And that is OpenAI.
cues.zh: 這是 OpenAI 的版本。

cues.en: Because that works quite out of the box, but it's a little more difficult with Azure.
cues.zh: OpenAI 基本上直接就能使用，但 Azure 稍微麻煩。

cues.en: Because if we just do normal Azure without, let me comment this in so we can see it running,
cues.zh: 如果直接照一般 Azure 的方式執行，我先取消註解，

cues.en: it will actually throw an error message.
cues.zh: 它會拋出錯誤。

cues.en: And it will say that image gen deployment must be provided to header XMS OpenAI image generation deployment.
cues.zh: 錯誤要求在 x-ms-openai-image-generation-deployment 標頭中，提供圖片生成的部署名稱。

cues.en: This is a little annoying thing because it can't just wrap this.
cues.zh: 這有點麻煩，因為不能只靠工具物件處理。

cues.en: It needs to know the deployment name.
cues.zh: 它還需要知道部署名稱。

cues.en: And in order to do that, we simply go in on the Azure OpenAI client and down in the transport area,
cues.zh: 因此到 Azure OpenAI 用戶端的 Transport 設定，

cues.en: we can add a HTTP client because they ask for a header.
cues.zh: 加入 HttpClient，因為它要求的是一個標頭。

cues.en: So we can just add that header here.
cues.zh: 接著就在這裡加入該標頭。

cues.en: Annoying that we need to do it, especially when the deployment name is the same as the OpenAI name, but they must have their reasons in order to do that.
cues.zh: 尤其部署名稱與 OpenAI 模型名稱相同時，還要做這件事有點煩，不過他們應該有自己的理由。

cues.en: But if we do it like that, and let me skip OpenAI and jump to Azure, we can do exactly the same code as before.
cues.zh: 完成後，跳過 OpenAI、直接執行 Azure，就能使用完全相同的程式碼。

cues.en: So this is the same code.
cues.zh: 也就是這一段。

cues.en: We can ask for normal text, but we can also ask for an image.
cues.zh: 可以要求一般文字，也能要求圖片。

cues.en: And again, the code is luckily the same among all three different clients,
cues.zh: 幸好三種用戶端的回覆處理程式碼相同，

cues.en: and we just need to wait for the image to be generated.
cues.zh: 只要等待圖片生成。

cues.en: And here we have the dog from Azure OpenAI.
cues.zh: 現在這就是 Azure OpenAI 產生的小狗。

cues.en: And of course, we can't judge which dog is the cutest because it's AI.
cues.zh: 當然不能直接比較哪隻比較可愛，因為 AI，

cues.en: They will generate new dogs every single time.
cues.zh: 每次都會產生不同的小狗。

cues.en: And then there's Foundry, and Foundry have the same thing with this special header.
cues.zh: 接著是 Foundry，它也需要相同的特殊標頭。

cues.en: So I'm giving the same HTTP client to that.
cues.zh: 所以把相同的 HttpClient 傳給它。

cues.en: And the client needs its OpenAI client.
cues.zh: 再從 ProjectClient 取得 OpenAIClient。

cues.en: And I mentioned that the image client doesn't work, and we can see that if I just call that image client here, I can get an image client,
cues.zh: 剛才提到 ImageClient 不能使用；這裡雖然能取得物件，

cues.en: but the second I try to generate anything, I just get a not found.
cues.zh: 但一開始生成圖片就會收到 Not Found。

cues.en: It's simply not implemented in the Foundry project system.
cues.zh: 因為 Foundry Project 系統根本沒有實作那個端點。

cues.en: So the reason why the image client is there is because it's just inherited from the OpenAI client, the NuGet package.
cues.zh: 之所以看得到 ImageClient，只是因為它繼承自 OpenAI NuGet 套件的用戶端。

cues.en: But you can see them, but you can't use them for anything.
cues.zh: 所以看得到方法，卻無法使用。

cues.en: So that is the reason why we want to not use image clients, but instead just give it as a tool just like we saw before.
cues.zh: 因此不要使用 ImageClient，而是像剛才一樣，把圖片生成當成工具提供。

cues.en: So if we run it again,
cues.zh: 再次執行，

cues.en: and jump the way down to Foundry. Oh. Oh.
cues.zh: 直接跳到 Foundry。喔，

cues.en: I jumped a little too much.
cues.zh: 我跳過太多了。

cues.en: The reason why this failed was that I didn't give it an HTTP client.
cues.zh: 失敗是因為還沒有把 HttpClient 傳進去。

cues.en: I jumped these lines here.
cues.zh: 剛才跳過了這幾行。

cues.en: So now it should be okay.
cues.zh: 現在應該沒問題了。

cues.en: And we can go in, do the exact same agent, ask the exact same questions,
cues.zh: 建立相同的代理程式，提出相同問題，

cues.en: and let it run to the end to get our cute dog.
cues.zh: 執行到底，就能取得可愛的小狗。

cues.en: So this means that, for example, in my sample about a chatbot, where I actually switched between this image generation
cues.zh: 這代表，例如我先前的聊天機器人範例，還自己切換圖片生成用戶端，

cues.en: and made my own tool with all the things of image generation, I didn't have the need for that because I could just have used this one instead
cues.zh: 並自行包裝完整的圖片生成工具；其實不用那麼麻煩，直接用這個工具即可，

cues.en: and know about the special extra thing we need to set up here.
cues.zh: 只要記得 Azure 額外的標頭設定。

cues.en: But if I had done that, we would have had the inline images, and it would have been much simpler for the system to run.
cues.zh: 這樣圖片就能直接出現在回覆中，整個系統會簡單得多。

cues.en: So this is quite cool that we can do this.
cues.zh: 能做到這一點非常不錯。

cues.en: There's still clients that can't be done with the Foundry, like, for example, speech-to-text, real-time, and so on.
cues.zh: Foundry 目前仍有一些不支援的用戶端，例如語音轉文字、Realtime 等。

cues.en: And for that, we still need the Azure OpenAI client.
cues.zh: 那些功能仍然需要 Azure OpenAI 的用戶端。

cues.en: But this is just one less thing because end of day, what we're really trying to do is trying to get rid of
cues.zh: 但現在少了一項限制，因為我們最終的目標，

cues.en: that we have both an OpenAI client and an Azure OpenAI client.
cues.zh: 是避免同時維護 OpenAIClient 與 AzureOpenAIClient 兩種。

cues.en: We want to slowly go toward a path where we either have an OpenAI client that connects to Azure
cues.zh: 希望逐漸走向只用 OpenAIClient 連到 Azure，

cues.en: or the Microsoft Foundry whenever we need the Foundry-specific bits and then get rid of Azure OpenAI client.
cues.zh: 或需要 Foundry 專屬功能時使用 Microsoft Foundry，然後移除 AzureOpenAIClient。

cues.en: And Microsoft is trying to get rid of it, but there's still a few things here and there that can't be removed away.
cues.zh: Microsoft 也正朝這方向努力，只是仍有一些功能還不能完全替代。

cues.en: But this is just one less thing we need to worry about because we can now get the image in there.
cues.zh: 不過現在可以在 Responses 中取得圖片，就少一項需要擔心的事情。

cues.en: So that's everything for this video.
cues.zh: 這支影片的內容就是這些。

cues.en: See you in the next one.
cues.zh: 我們下支影片見。
